decision_register.policy: Local is source of truth; new Public only; no old Public data/guest order/media backfill

user_scope: Replace broken/offline/blocked Public through a fresh empty Public without requiring the old host, with one URL and a confirmation. Catalog, images and staff published by existing Local sync.

implemented.item: Owner-approved fresh unpaired Public issues short-lived pairing code, proven zero preexisting installations/orders; Public identity remains per-installation
Reuse ordinary Public setup pair(replacement_mode=true); block guest intake with forward-only public_move_intake_paused even during regular Local projection sync
Signed HMAC activation only once Public guest revision and availability are present

Local staged replacement with original binding unchanged until normal Local full sync + complete media, then atomic config commit, signed Public activation, Local ledger completion and retry-safe recovery state
Single existing Local Connections Public URL input, owner approval and automatic media-batch retries, with Resume on failure; do not expose legacy pairing types to end user
Actual cumulative pinned R249 Public source plus R256/257/259 overlays extended to 244 files, 11 migrations and no modification of preceding 10 migration bytes

verified_ci.limitations: Public and Local ledger only, not actual deployed two-server Local publisher/order lifecycle.

verified_ci.notes: Latest R260 Public gate atomic intake-flag clear and normal Local HMAC projection verification succeeded. No actual end-to-end Local production host or installable package.

excluded: Fetching old Public for preflight, export or recovery
Transfer or reconciliation of Public-only pending guest orders, pictures, financial data, DB tables or history
Automated restoration of inaccessible old Public
Complex generic snapshots, multi-stage Public data migration engine or host-specific defaults
Changing Local databases, café production system, main or CURRENT in QA

pending.item: Real Local admin browser E2E connected to independently installed fresh Public: owner approve, server-side pair, full Local sync/catalog/media/staff, guest order and receipt arriving back in Local
One interrupted internet run across staged pair/sync and successful automatic resume; UI shows correct pending state and never opens guest ordering prematurely
Cumulative official Local update and Public fresh/update packages from byte-traceable latest accepted source with installation QA across supported baseline versions
Guest QR/legacy domain delivery to new Public after DNS/host move, customer-specific host routing
Additional separate Local machine relocation/Windows runtime/printing recovery

known_limits: Target for automatic replacement must be a fresh/unpaired Public installation with no existing installation records, orders or guest projections. It need not be a newly created database if the owner install is valid and empty.
An old Public-only order that never reached Local can be unrecoverable; the operator receives one explicit confirmation warning.
R260 uses a brief protected Local file for new pairing credentials between requests; an ambiguous remote pairing acknowledgement is deliberately not retried blindly.
Fresh Public installation must include the R260 intake-pause migration/owner route; an older unqualified target cannot silently bypass the gate.
The original Local business data and config are unchanged until the first new-target sync succeeds; after config commit and before intake activation a retry state is retained.
next_action: Run ONE actual two-host Local→Public operator end-to-end: fresh Public no orders with old URL offline; confirm initial catalog/media, guest order reaches Local; interrupt mid-sync and retry. Then build a traceable cumulative local updater+Public installer, run one install/upgrade smoke and release only after clean real source parity. Do not add extra migration scenarios or old Public backfill.
